newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hardie sells unit to Chubb.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hardie sells unit to Chubb.

text.p: James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell its building services unit to Chubb Security Plc for A$220 million.

The company said the Australian unit of Chubb would acquire James Hardie Building Services (JHBS), which consists of the fire protection and building automation businesses in Australia and New Zealand.
JHBS had sales of about A$250 million in the year the March 31. It employs about 1,700 people and has net assets of about A$80 million. The sale is conditional on regulatory approvals.
This is the second asset sale involving the two companies in the last 12 months.
James Hardie sold its security monitoring and manpower business to Chubb in December 1995 for an undisclosed sum.
Chubb also acquired the MSS Security business of Mayne Nickless Ltd in May 1996 for about A$41 million.
